packageRules.description: Pin katex to 0.16.x: rehype-katex@7 and micromark-extension-math@3 both depend on katex ^0.16.0, so bumping the root dep only swaps the stylesheet while 0.16 still renders the markup. KaTeX 0.18 changed its CSS classes, which breaks the build's rendering check. Revisit when rehype-katex ships 0.18 support.
